The committee was described as providing independent recommendations to NOAA.
The appointment release does not claim that demographic or sector diversity proves neutral outcomes or fair selection.

sources.title: ACES Membership
retrieved_facts: The published roster contains seventeen members with named affiliations and two-year terms ending 2026-08-30.
The charter language calls for fairly balanced membership of no more than twenty-five members across relevant professional fields.
The public roster establishes membership and affiliation, not each member's applicant history, nomination score, exercised influence, or outcome effect.

sources.title: Advisory Committee on Excellence in Space
retrieved_facts: ACES provided advice and recommendations on commercial-space policy, regulation, and related matters.
The committee established three subcommittees and operated under a charter signed in 2024.
The Secretary of Commerce determined that its purposes had been fulfilled and terminated the committee effective 2025-02-28.
The public description supports advisory rather than binding executive, budget, licensing, veto, or enforcement authority.

sources.title: When is the Federal Advisory Committee Act applicable?
retrieved_facts: Federal advisory committees must be chartered before acting and must be balanced in represented points of view and committee functions.
FACA requires public notice, open meetings subject to lawful exceptions, a designated federal officer, and publicly inspectable minutes.
Procedural balance and transparency do not establish that recommendations are adopted or that the committee has binding counterpower.
